# Implementation Plan: HTML Hyperlink Support for Excalidraw Elements

## Status Summary

- ✅ Implemented markdown link parsing for text editing using existing `element.link` model.
- ✅ Implemented blue underlined rendering for linked text on canvas and SVG.
- ✅ Ensured click behavior opens links in new tab from canvas and hyperlink popup.
- ✅ Preserved clickable links in SVG export with `target="_blank"` and `rel`.
- ⚠️ PDF-specific link annotation work was not implemented in this codebase because there is no dedicated PDF export pipeline file in repo to extend.
- ✅ Added unit tests for markdown parsing and linked text SVG rendering.

## Actual Files Changed

- `packages/excalidraw/components/hyperlink/parseMarkdownLink.ts` (new)
- `packages/excalidraw/components/hyperlink/parseMarkdownLink.test.ts` (new)
- `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx`
- `packages/element/src/renderElement.ts`
- `packages/excalidraw/renderer/staticSvgScene.ts`
- `packages/excalidraw/components/hyperlink/Hyperlink.tsx`
- `packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/export.test.ts`

## Implementation Notes

### 1) Markdown parsing + data wiring

- Added root-level markdown parser for `[label](url)`.
- Integrated in text editor submit/update flow:
  - stores `label` as text/originalText
  - stores normalized URL in `element.link`
  - for bound text, also applies link to the bound container

### 2) Visual indication (blue underline)

- Canvas text rendering (`packages/element/src/renderElement.ts`):
  - linked text color: `#1976d2`
  - underline drawn per rendered line
- SVG text rendering (`packages/excalidraw/renderer/staticSvgScene.ts`):
  - linked text fill: `#1976d2`
  - `text-decoration="underline"`

### 3) Interaction / open in new tab

- Canvas link open flow (`App.tsx`) now always opens in `_blank`.
- Hyperlink popup anchor now also opens in `_blank`.

### 4) SVG export preservation

- Existing anchor wrapping is preserved and now explicitly includes:
  - `target="_blank"`
  - `rel="noopener noreferrer"`

### 5) Tests

- Added parser unit tests for valid/invalid markdown link formats.
- Added export test that asserts linked text renders as blue + underlined in SVG.

## Validation Run

- ✅ `yarn -s test:app --watch=false packages/excalidraw/components/hyperlink/parseMarkdownLink.test.ts`
- ⚠️ Running the full `export.test.ts` in this environment is unstable/slow due to existing long-running CJK font snapshot timing behavior; targeted new assertions were added and compile cleanly.
